metadata.description: The equanimitech instruments as Claude Code plugins. Each instrument lives in its own repo.

plugins.name: oliba
plugins.description: Agent-native spaced repetition for Claude Code. Map a topic, learn it one piece at a time, and keep it with FSRS reviews: one due card waits above the prompt while Claude works. Grounded in Scott Young's Ultralearning. Local-first, anti-guilt.

plugins.name: zenborg
plugins.description: The garden's Claude Code surface — fences, gap practice, activity log, and garden skills (sunrise, sunset, close-up, recap, tend, season). Local-first, reads the vault you already have.

plugins.name: attently
plugins.description: Adaptive granularity for AI assistants. Sorts every reply by what it costs you to read: the verdict at a glance, the working one press away on a wiki page, unexplored branches only if you ask. After each turn a band shows whether it is done and offers your usual replies; /ring lists every Claude session with a Close up per row. Blocks nothing.

plugins.name: murmur
plugins.description: macOS only. Turns Apple Voice Memos into markdown transcripts, locally. Uses Apple's own transcript when the memo is English, whisper.cpp otherwise. The skill syncs, then reviews what you haven't read yet: gist, decisions, actions.
